description: Add redemption code system: database migration, model, service, admin CRUD (create/bulk-generate/disable codes, view all code history), and customer code redemption endpoint with UI
steps: Create migration database/migrations/2024_01_01_000009_create_redemption_codes_table.php with columns: id, code (unique string), token_amount (integer), status (enum: active/used/expired/disabled), used_by (nullable FK to users), used_at (nullable timestamp), created_by (FK to users), note (nullable text), timestamps
Create migration database/migrations/2024_01_01_000010_add_tier_to_users_table.php adding 'tier' column (string, default 'bronze') to users table

Create model app/Models/RedemptionCode.php with fillable fields, casts, relationships (usedBy -> User, createdBy -> User), status constants (STATUS_ACTIVE, STATUS_USED, STATUS_EXPIRED, STATUS_DISABLED), and scope methods for filtering

Create service app/Services/RedemptionCodeService.php with methods: redeem(User $user, string $code) - validates code is active/unused, marks as used, credits tokens via TokenService; generateCodes(int $count, int $tokenAmount, int $adminId, ?string $note) - bulk creates codes with random strings; disableCode(RedemptionCode $code) - sets status to disabled if not already used

Create service app/Services/TierService.php with methods: calculateTier(User $user) - counts completed renders and returns tier name based on thresholds (0-5=bronze, 6-20=silver, 21-50=gold, 51+=diamond); updateUserTier(User $user) - recalculates and saves tier to user model. Add constants for TIER_BRONZE, TIER_SILVER, TIER_GOLD, TIER_DIAMOND and TIER_THRESHOLDS array

Create controller app/Http/Controllers/Admin/RedemptionCodeController.php with methods: index (list all codes with pagination, search, status filter), create (show form), store (create single code), bulkGenerate (create multiple codes), history (full redemption history view with filters by user/date/status/search), show (single code detail), disable (mark code as disabled), userHistory (show codes used by specific user)

Create controller app/Http/Controllers/RedeemCodeController.php with methods: showForm (display the code redemption UI section), redeem (POST - validate code, call RedemptionCodeService::redeem, return success/error with JSON for AJAX)

Create Blade views for admin: resources/views/admin/codes/index.blade.php (list all codes with search/filter, bulk generate button), resources/views/admin/codes/create.blade.php (form to create single or bulk codes), resources/views/admin/codes/history.blade.php (full redemption history with filters - the main 'check code' page showing who used what, when, how many tokens)
Create Blade view for customer: resources/views/components/redeem-code.blade.php - a section with input field for code, 'Doi code' button, success/error messages. Uses Alpine.js for AJAX submission

Add routes to routes/web.php: POST /redeem-code (customer redeems), GET /admin/codes (list), GET /admin/codes/create (form), POST /admin/codes (store single), POST /admin/codes/bulk-generate (bulk), GET /admin/codes/{code}/history (single code detail), POST /admin/codes/{code}/disable (disable), GET /admin/code-history (full history with filters)
Update resources/views/layouts/admin.blade.php sidebar navigation to add 'Redemption Codes' link pointing to admin.codes.index route
Update resources/views/templates/index.blade.php header area to add the code redemption section (input + button) and show the user's current tier badge
Update resources/views/templates/editor.blade.php to show tier badge in header, replace 'Nap token' link with a code redemption form/link
Update app/Http/Controllers/Admin/DashboardController.php to add redemption code count and active code count to the dashboard
Update resources/views/admin/dashboard.blade.php to show redemption codes stats card
Update app/Models/User.php to add 'tier' to fillable, add redemptionCodes() hasMany relationship, and add completedRenders() method
Update TokenService.php to add a new type TYPE_REDEEM = 'redeem' constant usage or use existing TYPE_CREDIT for code redemptions (use description to differentiate)
Update app/Models/TokenTransaction.php to add TYPE_REDEEM constant
Integrate TierService into RenderPsdJob or RenderController so that after a successful render, the user's tier is recalculated automatically
acceptance_criteria: Migration file for redemption_codes table has all required columns and correct foreign key constraints
Migration file adds 'tier' column to users table with default 'bronze'
RedemptionCode model correctly defines relationships, fillable, casts, and status constants
RedemptionCodeService::redeem correctly validates code status, marks as used, credits tokens, and returns the transaction
RedemptionCodeService::generateCodes creates the specified number of codes with random 8-12 char uppercase alphanumeric strings
TierService correctly calculates tiers based on completed render count thresholds
Admin can view all codes, filter by status, search by code text or user
Admin can create a single code with custom text and token amount
Admin can bulk generate codes (e.g., 10 codes with 50 tokens each)
Admin can disable an unused code
Admin can view full redemption history showing: code, tokens, who used it, when, status
Customer can enter a code and receive tokens if valid
Customer sees their tier badge in the header
Used codes cannot be redeemed again
Disabled/expired codes return clear error message
All PHP files pass syntax check (php -l)
verification: Run php -l on all new/modified PHP files to verify no syntax errors
Verify migration files have proper up() and down() methods
Verify routes are properly defined in web.php with correct middleware groups
Verify Blade views extend correct layouts and use proper @section directives
Verify RedemptionCodeService uses DB::transaction for atomic operations
